source.note: 32b4abf and 1976005 change only the portal user registration form, tests, the CI workflow and two check scripts. Rust, SDK, frame runtime, migrations and registry inputs are identical to 9133d70, so the server, CLI and frame runtime stay at 9133d70.

history.observed: The isolated regression and the SDK ACL check passed; the representative app check failed after 16 s. That workflow kept no evidence. The same failure on 32b4abf, with evidence uploaded, was fixture_sql_failed: the check asked database readiness on the container's Unix socket, where the image's temporary initialization server answers before it restarts. Not a product fault. The check passed in the clean frozen checkout under Python 3.14 and 3.12.

runtime-regression.yml.observed: fixture_sql_failed in the representative app check (see above); nothing was deployed from this commit.
